about.purpose: Characters of the campaign and their photocards. Names follow data-source/terminology.source.json; every alias is searchable. Photocards are local files from Sources of Truth/Character Photocard and keep the provenance recorded in that repository's manifest.
about.photocardLicenceNote: Licence decided by the project owner (NuRichter): photocards are used under an open licence. Each card keeps its source and attribution from the repository manifest.

characters.name: Rimuru Tempest
characters.role: Head of state; Head of state; aerial reconnaissance; infiltration of the Imperial Capital; settlement

characters.name: Benimaru
characters.role: Supreme General; Supreme General; directed the double feigned defeat; present at the sealed space and the summit

characters.name: Gobta
characters.role: Corps commander; First Corps; wolf-rider charge; Blizzard Wolf Dance

characters.name: Geld
characters.role: Corps commander

characters.name: Gabiru
characters.role: Corps commander; Third Corps; airship boarding actions; Colossus airlift; solo attack on the eastern front
characters.nameConflicts: Official portal 'Gabiru' vs Yen Press 'Gabil'. The project's 'Gabil' matches Yen Press; either is defensible.

characters.name: Gobwa
characters.role: Detachment commander; Led the Kurenai advance force onto the eastern front
characters.nameConflicts: 'Gobya' is a fan-TL misreading of ゴブア.

characters.name: Hakuro
characters.role: Advisor; Advisor to the Kurenai advance force
characters.nameConflicts: Both official sources write 'Hakuro'; 'Hakurou' is the wiki's long-vowel form.

characters.name: Ramiris
characters.role: Theatre commander; Labyrinth structure, severing and revival; preserved the capital city

characters.name: Adalmann
characters.role: Sector commander; labyrinth attrition; Floor 70 defence with an undead legion of fewer than 40,000
characters.nameConflicts: Official portal 'Adalmann' vs Yen Press 'Adalman'. The project matches Yen Press.

characters.name: Testarossa
characters.role: Independent element, later ambassador; Envoy; closed the imperial retreat; decisive victory; ambassador to the Empire

characters.name: Ultima
characters.role: Engaged Faraga's flagship; despatched Veyron and Zonda

characters.name: Diablo
characters.role: Took the souls of the imperial camp and defeated Caligulio (V13 Ch4); in Rimuru's party; held back during the long night; summit attendee

characters.name: Shion
characters.role: Secretary; leads the Yomigaeri (~100) and her Pro-Guard (10,000 per V13 Ch4); in Rimuru's party in the Dream Fortress; summit attendee. Not killed in this war: the V15 Ch2 'killed' line is a flashback.

characters.name: Veldora Tempest
characters.japanese: ヴェルドラ＝テンペスト (title 暴風竜)
characters.role: Storm Dragon; duel with Velgrynd over Jura (V14 Epilogue-V15); dominated by Rudra after Kondo's bullet, then recovered by Rimuru

characters.name: Gadora
characters.role: Relayed encrypted contact; rode and fired the Floor Guardian Colossus at Velgrynd
characters.nameConflicts: Light-novel-only character: the only official English form is Yen Press 'Gadora' (also the exact reading of ガドラ, ga-do-ra). 'Gadra' is the wiki/fan form used by the project and the photocard archive. Low-impact conflict; switching is optional.

characters.name: Phobio
characters.role: Attached to Gobya's force on the eastern front
characters.nameConflicts: Epithet 'Panthertooth' not verified in an official source.

characters.name: Veyron
characters.role: Veyron and Zonda arrive on the eastern front
characters.nameConflicts: Portal writes 'Veryon' (likely a typo of ヴェイロン = Veyron).

characters.name: Zonda
characters.role: Veyron and Zonda arrive on the eastern front

characters.name: Gazel Dwargo
characters.role: Head of state and field commander; Fortified the gate; assessed the campaign; committed the Sky Knights

characters.name: Dorf
characters.role: Formation commander; Heavy assault force; took joint command with Gabil
characters.nameConflicts: Yen Press 'Dolph' vs anime/wiki 'Dorf'; kept 'Dorf'. He captains the Pegasus Knights - check F-DWA-003 ('Heavy armed assault force' under Dorf) against the source.

characters.name: Vaughn
characters.role: Counsel to Gazel on the eastern front
characters.nameConflicts: 'Ben' (fan TL) = バーン = Vaughn; identity inferred from role. Yen Press spelling not verified.

characters.name: Anrietta
characters.role: Detected the ritual behind the Scorch Dragon
characters.nameConflicts: Yen Press 'Henrietta' vs anime/wiki 'Anrietta'; kept 'Anrietta'.

characters.name: Rudra Nam Ul Nasca
characters.japanese: ルドラ・ナム・ウル・ナスカ
characters.role: Head of state; Ordered mobilisation; the truth of the throne uncovered
characters.nameConflicts: UNRESOLVED official conflict: the Yen Press LN uses 'Ludora' (and 'Nam-ul-Nasca' once in v16); the katakana ルドラ and the anime-following wiki give 'Rudra'. Canonical kept as 'Rudra Nam Ul Nasca' (direct romanisation, matches wiki, photocard archive and project); 'Ludora' is the Yen Press alias. 'Naam', 'Ulu', 'Nazca' are fan-TL errors.

characters.name: Caligulio
characters.japanese: カリギュリオ・ヒース
characters.role: General (one of the Three Great Generals), head of the Armored Division; commanded the Jura invasion; killed by Diablo, resurrected, held prisoner in Tempest, summit delegate, leads the repatriation
characters.nameConflicts: Official English (Yen Press) is 'Caligulio', which is also the closer reading of カリギュリオ (ka-ri-gyu-ri-o). 'Calgurio' is the wiki/fan form. Rank: wiki has him as General commanding the Armored Division (Velgrynd holds the Marshal post); 'Marshal' comes from the fan TL - verify.

characters.name: Gaster
characters.role: Lieutenant General, Magitank Force; killed by Testarossa at his headquarters (V13 Ch2)
characters.nameConflicts: 'Geist' is the fan-TL rendering of ガスター. Identity confirmed by role: Lt. General commanding the magitank ('Magic Chariot') force under Caligulio.

characters.name: Farraga
characters.role: Major General, Flying Combat Corps (100 airships committed); killed by Ultima's Nuclear Flame (V13 Ch2)
characters.nameConflicts: Yen Press and wiki agree on 'Farraga'.

characters.name: Minitz
characters.role: Major General, Caligulio's right hand; led the labyrinth assault and was killed there; resurrected; summit delegate
characters.nameConflicts: 'Minute' is a mistranslation (ミニッツ read as 'minutes').

characters.name: Gradim
characters.role: Commander of the Magic Beast Division (30,000); killed by Carillon during his awakening sleep at the Dwargon eastern front, remains devoured by Vega (V15 Ch3)
characters.nameConflicts: Yen Press spelling NOT verified (name absent from v16). ラ is r/l-ambiguous; 'Gradim' is the wiki title and the standard romanisation. 'Grand Admiral' is doubtful: wiki lists him as one of the Three Great Generals commanding the Magic Beast Division - verify against the source.

characters.name: Yuuki Kagurazaka
characters.japanese: 神楽坂優樹 (ユウキ・カグラザカ)
characters.role: Legion commander; Hybrid Legion; led the coup conspiracy; coordinated with Tempest via Gadra
characters.nameConflicts: Indonesian TL occasionally writes 'Yuki'.

characters.name: Tatsuya Kondo
aliases: Stalker of the Halls of Information
characters.japanese: 近藤達也（タツヤ・コンドウ）
characters.role: Lieutenant, Imperial Intelligence Bureau; killed Miranda; guarded Kagali's ritual and fought Gazel on the Dwargon eastern front; shot Veldora; killed by Carrera (V15 Ch5)

characters.name: Velgrynd

characters.nameConflicts: Name consistent everywhere. Title 灼熱竜: Yen Press 'Flame Dragon' vs wiki/fan TL 'Scorch Dragon'.

characters.name: Samuel
characters.role: Major General commanding the 300-airship flotilla and the imperial flagship; killed by Testarossa's Death Streak (V15 Ch4) and revived in a homunculus (V16 Ch3)
characters.nameConflicts: The Indonesian fan TL (V14-V15) writes Samuel; Yen Press V16 writes Major General Zamdo for the same officer (v14.txt:5954; v16.txt:9181-9183). Japanese not located.
